name: Adjustment Compensation 1
definition: Specifies the compensation for a valuation request.

InitialAmount.name: Initial Amount
InitialAmount.definition: Compensation calculated for the request before charges have been added.

DueCharges.name: Due Charges
DueCharges.definition: Charges added to the initial amount.

AmountDue.name: Amount Due
AmountDue.definition: Compensation due for the request after charges have been added.

CompensationAgent.name: Compensation Agent
CompensationAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the party or agent to whom compensation is due.

CompensationAccount.name: Compensation Account
CompensationAccount.definition: Account to which compensation is due.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Date range for which the compensation applies.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Interest rate of a financial instrument used to calculate the compensation.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the valuation response.
